name: can-loopback-routing-suite
description: Verifies the routing time of a gateway DUT that relays can0<->can1 on real hardware: payload integrity, routing time (TS_rx - TS_tx, both raw wire timestamps, gRPC call overhead excluded), and no drops -- using can0/can1 wired onto one shared physical bus as a DUT-free stand-in. A methodology check, not a performance benchmark -- the default 5ms bound is deliberately loose.

tests.name: can0->can1 routing: payload, routing time, no drops
tests.description: 100 sequence-tagged frames injected via the gateway's FrameService on can0, routing time measured as TS_message_on_can1 - TS_message_on_can0 using raw SocketCAN reads on both sides.
